source_row.english: Coveting consists of a wrong (that is, an improper) desire for another's wealth, which leads to a wish that one make it his own. Harmful intent is the desire to hurt another living being, a desire which comes from the attitude of hating him. And mistaken view is the idea that neither virtue nor non-virtue even exists. Next we discuss the literal meaning of the expression "a path of action." 79 Explanation of the Expression "Path of Action"

spans.rationale: Established mental-action compound; no invented BRNAB/SEMS members inside the single English word.
This first evaluative word is the initial wrong in the desire definition, not the final mistaken-view compound.
Explanatory continuative STE introduces the clarification of wrong as improper. Exclude parentheses, comma and an.
The complete negative evaluative expression includes the source agentive/adverbial S. Do not cut PAS into PA plus a detached S or fabricate an im/proper member.
The whole genitive phrase owns the complete possessive another's. This avoids breaking the English possessive into an unlicensed suffix or assigning the GYI relation to an unrelated of.
The wealth sense is required by the coveting object. This NOR is not the error sense used in the preceding speech definitions.
First LA marks the object of desire, rendered for before another's wealth. The later LA attached to a living being has no equivalent separate for.
The attachment/desire verb supplies the first English desire, modified by wrong/improper. It is distinct from the later two English repetitions in the harmful-intent definition.
The sequential/causal linker joins this desire to the wish to possess. Leads to supplies that relation; the supplied relative which and determiner a remain outside.

The complete ownership expression is rendered his own, with the possessor referring to the preceding one. Its mine/sense-of-ownership lexical evidence supports the possessive content; the object it remains outside.
This first independent BYED gives make in making the wealth his own. Do not copy it onto the later hurt clause or onto a supplied auxiliary.
First wishing verb owns wish in the coveting sentence, preserving the attached declarative ending outside the complete PA syllable.
Established mental-action compound, with two unique strictly tighter members below.
Harmful member belongs to the category title, not to the later hurt verb.
Intent member belongs within the category compound. No independent mind word is invented in the English.
The complete sentient-being expression supplies living being. Another and the later him are English participants outside this noun.
The hatred verb owns hating. Although the full glossary also has attitude of hating, the narrower claim keeps the adjacent RNAM PAR aspect construction from being silently absorbed.
Complete lexical records independently support hurt. The following BYED is not separately assigned another English action or the infinitive to.
Second Tibetan wishing verb owns the first desire within the harmful-intent definition. The later a desire which comes is English repetition of the same referent and remains unbanked.
The first positive virtue is separate from the later occurrence inside non-virtue.
The coordinator is rendered nor under the shared MED PAR negative scope. This does not assign DANG the negation or existence predicate itself.
Whole established negative virtue compound preserves the printed hyphen. No unsupported non negative-affix span is added.
Unique positive lexical member inside the whole non-virtue parent. The printed hyphen gives a complete English word boundary; no subword flag or detached negative affix is needed.
This first LTA BA is the belief/idea of denying virtue and non-virtue. It is separate from the following named mistaken-view compound.
Complete doctrinal category compound owns the exact lowercase title in this sentence, not either Path of Action heading occurrence.
Wrong/mistaken member is unique inside the category title. Preserve the complete PAR syllable.
View member lies inside the category title and differs from the preceding LTA BA/idea.

omissions.tib: ni occurrences; bound genitive and declarative endings
omissions.reason: The topic/definition and bound grammar is distributed among consists of, is, anaphoric possession and sentence closure. No isolated topic or ending is asserted absent.

omissions.tib: la after sems can; rnam par zhugs pas; byed after gnod pa
omissions.reason: The living-being object relation is recast into hurt another living being and hating him; there is no secure separate LA/to. RNAM PAR ZHUGS PAS contributes entering or being engaged in a hatred mode, while English uses comes from the attitude of; neither comes nor attitude securely belongs to a single atom. The second BYED forms the harm-doing construction and has no independent remaining verb beyond GNOD PA/hurt. Omit these uncertain/distributed pieces rather than false nulls.

The negative existence predicate governs both virtue and non-virtue, while English distributes it through neither, nor and exists. Neither alone drops existence and full neither...exists would swallow two separately aligned nouns. No single contiguous faithful atom is banked; the uncertainty is not absence.

omissions.reason: Supplied definition frames, articles, relative pronouns, object/subject references, auxiliaries and duplicated desire remain unwrapped. NAS/leads to and STE/that is own only their actual connectors. The shared negative-existential phrase remains unbanked as explained above.
